To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the strategies used by multinational enterprises in the mining sector to address informal artisanal, and small scale miners vary across governance levels.
multinational enterprises in mining are increasingly using cooperative strategies to address the informal artisanal, miners that compete with them for resources in the mining sector.
MNEs in Ghana are increasingly engaging with artisanal miners in order to gain access to gold resources and to improve their social license to operate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the sustainability of the gold mining industry in Ghana.
the sustainability of the MNE strategy of cooperation with informal miners in the gold sector of Ghana.
how MNEs can contribute to sustainability by addressing informal miners in a way that does not rely on the state.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MNE strategy of cooperation with artisanal miners has the potential to contribute to sustainable development.
the MNEs are using a mix of strategies to deal with the informal miners.
, MNEs can use a cooperative strategy with artisanal miners to address the challenges in the gold mining industry in Ghana.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cooperative strategy has the potential for sustainable outcomes, but it is contingent upon the ability of the MNEs to build the necessary institutional capacity to manage the informal miners.
a cooperative strategy is a viable alternative to political strategies for addressing informal mining.
the MNEs have developed a strategy to manage the informal mining sector that involves a combination of the political strategy and the cooperative strategy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MNEs that are able to develop a cooperative strategy with artisanal and small scale miners are able to achieve sustainability.
MNEs can use the state as a resource to protect their own tenure but also as a resource to build cooperative relationships with informal miners.
a cooperative approach can be used to address the challenges of informal miners, while at the same time improving the sustainability of MNE operations.
